arguments.body: Hello, the tenant contact on file for Flat 22, 148 Lantern Quay is Clara Jenkins: 07700 900625 (enter this code when calling), exactly as in our job email of 21 Nov. We are checking whether the tenant has a better direct number and will pass it on if so. Please book the visit with the tenant and confirm the date to us. Scope: replace the lock on the conservatory back door and supply 4 new keys (2 tenants, 1 agency, 1 landlord; the agency and landlord keys come to our office). The landlord has approved this work.
